company_description: Generac Holdings Inc. designs, manufactures, and distributes energy technology products and solutions worldwide. The company offers residential automatic standby generators, automatic transfer switch, air-cooled engine home standby generators, and liquid-cooled engine generators; Mobile Link, a remote monitoring system for home standby generators; propane tank monitoring solution; and smart home solutions, such as smart thermostats and a suite of home monitoring products. It also provides smart home energy management devices and sensors for heating and cooling system; smart doorbell cameras; and portable and inverter generators; multiple portable battery solutions; manual transfer switches; outdoor power equipment, including trimmers, field and brush mowers, log splitters, stump grinders, chipper shredders, lawn and leaf vacuums, and pressure washers and water pumps; and home energy storage systems. risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Investment Cycles
risks.summary: Residential and commercial investment cycles, interest rate variations, and commodity prices can reduce demand for products.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to residential and commercial investment cycles, interest rate fluctuations, commodity prices, and global economic conditions. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policies
risks.summary: Tariffs since Q1 2025 are creating inflationary pressures, reducing margins, and decreasing demand for certain products.
risks.score_rationale: Since Q1 2025, additional tariffs are impacting costs and margins. The company has implemented price increases that reduce demand. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions and commodity price fluctuations can reduce production capacity and margins.
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on the supply chain, exposed to disruptions and price fluctuations for raw materials and components. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Commodity and Component Price Volatility
risks.summary: Fluctuations in prices for raw materials, electronic components, and battery cells impact costs and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in steel, copper, aluminum, and electronic component prices. Recent acquisitions increase exposure to volatile battery cells. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Competitive Risks
risks.summary: Competition can reduce sales, market share, and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets (residential, commercial, industrial, data centers). Mentioned in Item 1 Business.

risks.title: Debt Structure Dependency
risks.summary: High debt structure can impact financial flexibility and the ability to invest in development.
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt with credit obligations. In July 2025, Term Loan A and Revolving Credit Facility were amended. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A Note 12.

risks.title: Geopolitical Instability and Currency Fluctuations
risks.summary: Geopolitical instability and currency fluctuations can impact sales and financial results from international operations.
risks.score_rationale: International operations expose the company to regional conflicts, foreign exchange risks, and political uncertainties. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Impact of Renewable Energy Mandates and Tax Incentive Changes
risks.summary: Changes in renewable energy mandates and investment tax credits can reduce demand for solar and storage systems.
risks.score_rationale: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) of July 2025 accelerated the phase-out of certain investment tax credits, negatively impacting the solar storage market. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.
